# Druid — Balance

## Talent Prototype

This compact prototype uses two normal talent tiers plus one capstone. Talent identity and icon slugs are sourced from the Classic tree named **Balance**. There are no per-node prerequisite chains; unlocks are controlled only by the structured tier thresholds in this JSON.

tier_1.name: Improved Wrath
tier_1.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

tier_2.name: Improved Thorns
tier_2.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

capstones.name: Moonkin Form
capstones.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.
